pred-sql: WITH ranked_stations AS ( SELECT rental_methods, capacity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rental_methods ORDER BY capacity) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY rental_methods) AS cnt FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_stations WHERE capacity IS NOT NULL ), median_by_method AS ( SELECT rental_methods, AVG(CAST(capacity AS REAL)) AS median_capacity FROM ranked_stations WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) GROUP BY rental_methods ) SELECT s.name FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_stations s JOIN median_by_method m ON s.rental_methods <=> m.rental_methods WHERE s.capacity > m.median_capacity AND s.station_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT start_station_id FROM new_york_citibike_citibike_trips WHERE start_station_id IS NOT NULL );

SELECT输出列不同：Gold SQL输出 rental_methods、name、capacity、station_id、latitude、longitude 共6列；Pred SQL仅输出 name 一列，缺少其他字段。2. 中位数计算方法不同：Gold SQL使用精确的插值中位数（加权平均），能正确处理任意数量的记录；Pred SQL使用取中间两个值的平均值（AVG），但在记录数为偶数时，其筛选条件 `rn IN ((cnt+1)/2, (cnt+2)/2)` 会产生非整数导致只取到一个中间值（例如 cnt=4 时 IN (2.5,3) 实际只匹配 rn=3），造成中位数计算错误，进而影响 `capacity > median` 的过滤结果。3. pred-sql: WITH project_gene_baseline AS ( SELECT project_short_name, Gene, AVG(Expr) AS avg_expr FROM qotm_paad_kirp_random_sample_1002 WHERE project_short_name IN ('TCGA-PAAD', 'TCGA-KIRP', 'PAAD', 'KIRP') AND Expr IS NOT NULL GROUP BY project_short_name, Gene ), high_expr_with_protein AS ( SELECT q.project_short_name, q.ID, q.Gene, q.Expr, b.avg_expr, q.Expr / b.avg_expr AS expr_vs_avg, p.protein_expression FROM qotm_paad_kirp_random_sample_1002 q JOIN project_gene_baseline b ON q.project_short_name = b.project_short_name AND q.Gene = b.Gene JOIN tcga_hg38_data_v0_protein_expression p ON q.project_short_name = p.project_short_name AND q.ID = p.sample_barcode AND q.Gene = p.gene_name WHERE q.project_short_name IN ('TCGA-PAAD', 'TCGA-KIRP', 'PAAD', 'KIRP') AND q.Expr IS NOT NULL AND b.avg_expr IS NOT NULL AND b.avg_expr > 0 AND q.Expr > 1.5 * b.avg_expr AND p.protein_expression IS NOT NULL ) SELECT project_short_name, Gene, COUNT(*) AS supporting_samples, ROUND(AVG(Expr), 4) AS avg_high_expr, ROUND(AVG(avg_expr), 4) AS project_gene_baseline_expr, ROUND(AVG(expr_vs_avg), 4) AS avg_fold_vs_baseline, ROUND(AVG(protein_expression), 4) AS avg_protein_expression FROM high_expr_with_protein GROUP BY project_short_name, Gene ORDER BY project_short_name, avg_fold_vs_baseline DESC, supporting_samples DESC;

pred-sql: WITH yearly_avg AS ( SELECT Modality AS Category, YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(AcquisitionDate)) AS Year, AVG(SliceThickness) AS avg_thickness FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.tcga_versioned_radiology_images_tcia_2018_06 GROUP BY Modality, YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(AcquisitionDate)) ), above_avg AS ( SELECT t.Modality AS Category, t.PatientID AS Entity, YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(t.AcquisitionDate)) AS Year, t.SliceThickness AS Measure, CASE WHEN t.SliceThickness > ya.avg_thickness THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS above FROM TCGA_MITELMAN.tcga_versioned_radiology_images_tcia_2018_06 t JOIN yearly_avg ya ON t.Modality = ya.Category AND YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(t.AcquisitionDate)) = ya.Year ), consecutive AS ( SELECT Category, Entity, Year, above, LAG(above) OVER (PARTITION BY Category, Entity ORDER BY Year) AS prev_above FROM above_avg ) SELECT DISTINCT Category, Entity FROM consecutive WHERE above = 1 AND prev_above = 1;
Effective diff desc: gold_sql使用EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AcquisitionDate)提取年份，而pred_sql使用YEAR(FROM_UNIXTIME(AcquisitionDate))，假设AcquisitionDate是Unix时间戳则语义等价，但如果是日期类型则FROM_UNIXTIME会导致错误，两种函数语义不等价且可能导致不同结果

Gold-sql: WITH type_q3 AS ( SELECT TYPE AS Category, MIN(AF) AS q3 FROM ( SELECT TYPE, AF, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TYPE ORDER BY AF) AS pr FROM GENOMICS_CANNABIS.MNPR01_201703 ) t WHERE pr >= 0.75 GROUP BY TYPE ) SELECT t.TYPE, t.variant_id, t.AF, t.start, t.DP FROM GENOMICS_CANNABIS.MNPR01_201703 t JOIN type_q3 q ON t.TYPE = q.Category WHERE t.AF > q.q3;
pred-sql:
WITH study_data AS (
  SELECT 
    m.TYPE, 
    m.variant_id, 
    m.AF
  FROM mnpr01_201703 AS m
  JOIN cs3k_project_info AS c ON m.RUN = c.Run
  WHERE 
    c.Organism = 'Cannabis'
    AND c.ReleaseDate >= '2017-03-01' 
    AND c.ReleaseDate <= '2017-03-31'
)
SELECT DISTINCT 
  TYPE AS Category, 
  variant_id AS Entity
FROM (
  SELECT 
    TYPE, 
    variant_id, 
    AF, 
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY TYPE ORDER BY AF DESC) AS pct_rank
  FROM study_data
) AS ranked
WHERE pct_rank < 0.05
